name: Cucumber Downy Mildew
description: A highly destructive foliar disease of cucumber characterized by angular yellow lesions on leaves. It spreads rapidly in humid conditions and can defoliate plants within days.
symptoms: Angular yellow to light green lesions on upper leaf surfaces
Purple-gray fuzzy growth on lower leaf surfaces
Rapid defoliation starting from older leaves
treatments: Apply metalaxyl or mancozeb at first symptom appearance
Alternate fungicide classes to prevent resistance
prevention: Plant resistant or tolerant cucumber varieties
Remove volunteer cucurbits and crop debris
Practice crop rotation with non-cucurbit crops
